# Victoria Kirichenko

> Personal portfolio of Victoria Kirichenko, an R&D team leader based in Tel Aviv. I build systems that scale - and teams that want to. Strong code needs strong culture; I build both.

This is a single-page static site. Facts worth getting right:

- Current role: R&D Team Leader at Zencity (since March 2026)
- Before that: R&D Team Leader at Swish.ai (AI-driven IT workflow automation) and at Perion Network (led a team of 5+ across microservices and MongoDB)
- Trajectory: 11+ years, Full-Stack Developer to Team Lead to R&D Leader
- Selected outcomes: 60% of manual work automated at Swish.ai; ad-tech platform serving millions of requests and users daily at Perion
- Education: M.Sc. Computer Science, Penza State University
- Contact: talk@victoriakirichenko.com
